bio.text: Mike Weissman is a Democrat who represents District 28 (Adams and Arapahoe counties) in the Colorado State Senate, where Ballotpedia says he took office on January 8, 2025.
Ballotpedia lists his prior office as the Colorado House of Representatives, District 36, from 2017 to 2025.
It says his professional experience includes advising organizations on how to use technology.
